req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /docs returns an HTTP 2xx response with Swagger UI content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML body containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type header is exactly 'text/html' (not JSON, not plain text), catching mutations that swap the docs renderer; (4) additional DT — verifying the exact status code 200 (not 201, not 204) to kill constant-mutation operators; (5) content assertion checks for 'swagger' keyword in body to kill mutations that serve an empty or wrong page.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialized with Swagger UI enabled (default)
GET /docs endpoint is registered by FastAPI automatically
expected: Response body contains 'swagger' (case-insensitive) indicating Swagger UI HTML
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.text.lower()
    assert "swagger" in body

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html()

tests.name: test_get_docs_content_type_is_html
preconditions: GET /docs is served as HTML, not JSON or plain text
trace: R-TASK-020: expected payload is Swagger UI HTML page
BVA: boundary between HTML and non-HTML response types
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_content_type_is_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert content_type.startswith("text/html")

test_get_docs_content_type_is_html()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_docs_returns_405_method_not_allowed():

    assert r.status_code == 405
